prompt: can you see if readme file is all upto date.

tasks.title: Refresh README to match the current CLI and runtime behavior
tasks.spec: Audit `README.md` against the live implementation in `agentflow/cli.py`, `agentflow/config.py`, `ARCHITECTURE.md`, `pyproject.toml`, and `setup.py`, then rewrite the README sections that have drifted. Update the usage section so it documents every current entry point (`agentflow "task"`, `agentflow --prompt-file <path>`, `agentflow -`, `status`, `log`, `resume`, `retry`, `clean`, and `config`) and include the important `agentflow clean --logs` behavior. Refresh the workflow description so it matches the actual runtime order: repo analysis, optional complexity gate, optional research, planning, scheduling, worker/reviewer rounds, merging, optional validation with one automatic fix task, cleanup, and notification. Correct prerequisites to reflect that either installed CLIs or API keys satisfy provider availability, not API keys only. Expand the configuration section so the documented keys match the current config surface, including `notify`, `planner_model`, `research_enabled`, `research_model`, `research_max_files`, and `validation_enabled`, and make sure allowed `prompt_strategy` values are accurate. Keep the README concise and user-facing, but remove outdated or incomplete claims so a new user can rely on it without reading the code.
tasks.rationale: This request is a documentation audit, and the drift is localized to the README. The current README omits real CLI entry points (`--prompt-file`, stdin, `clean`), misses `clean --logs`, understates the runtime pipeline by leaving out the gate/research/validation phases, and documents an older configuration surface. It also implies API keys are the only prerequisite even though the code accepts installed `claude` and `codex` CLIs. Because the affected behavior is all part of the same product surface and the change should only touch the main user-facing document, a single docs bugfix task is the right size and avoids unnecessary task coordination.
tasks.feedback: Escalated: agent made no meaningful progress after round 1. Diff similarity 98%.
tasks.error: Stale retry loop detected on round 2. Branch preserved for manual review.
